tools.name: cad.info
tools.description: Inspect a drawing (DXF or DWG) in your workspace: entity counts by type, layers, blocks, layouts and the model-space extents. Reads only. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named.

tools.name: cad.run
tools.description: Run up to 64 commands from the cad engine's catalog, in order, on the drawing (DXF or DWG) at `path` in your workspace, or on a new empty drawing, then write it as DXF, DWG, SVG, PNG or PDF (by `format` or the extension of `out`; a PNG at most `max_side` pixels long) to `out` when given. Each command is {id, params}. Only reviewed commands run: those the skill's commands.md lists untagged (work inside the document), except `setvar`; anything that reaches other files, code, the network, devices or the app is refused before any command runs. Paths are relative to your workspace, and `out` must be a new file. Read the cad-engine skill first.
